notes.chapter_title: Fugal Style
notes.summary: Editor's discussion of codetta vs episode: Bruhn does not distinguish them; Schulenberg calls episodes the longer, articulated passages; Czaczkes/Dürr use 'Zwischentakt'; Prout classes those within the exposition as codettas. Groocock requires episodes to develop material or modulate; a codetta merely refocuses the key; he also uses 'extension' for passages prolonging a key toward a cadence.
